blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Reinforcement learning (RL) can elicit specialized visual capabilities in vision-language models (VLMs), yet jointly optimizing heterogeneous objectives often introduces cross-capability gradient conflicts. Training experts independently mitigates this interference, but direct reward optimization may entangle specialized knowledge with reward-hacking biases. This paper proposes Skill-Decoupled On-Policy Expert Distillation (SCOPED), which trains capability-specific experts and extracts explicit skills through reward-guided reflection. During on-policy distillation, these skills guide expert supervision while remaining unavailable to the unified student, encouraging it to internalize procedural knowledge without explicit skills at inference time. Across eight multimodal benchmarks, SCOPED consistently outperforms the backbone and mixed-capability RL, demonstrating the effectiveness of skill-decoupled on-policy expert distillation for integrating independently acquired capabilities. Further analyses reveal interference during joint capability optimization and suggest that skill augmentation promotes more consistent expert trajectories, greater attention to task-relevant visual evidence, and better preservation of specialized expertise in the unified student. All code and data are available at https://github.com/NEUIR/SCOPED.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities across a broad range of multimodal tasks ( Bai et al., 2025a ; Wang et al., 2025b ) . To further enhance their downstream multimodal capabilities, recent studies have increasingly adopted Reinforcement Learning (RL) ( Yu et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026a ; Liu et al., 2026a ) to cultivate specialized visual understanding skills through task-specific rewards, including fine-grained visual perception ( Sun et al., 2025 ; Xiong et al., 2026 ) , visual grounding ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) , and complex multimodal reasoning ( Xia et al., 2025 ; Peng et al., 2025 ) . These approaches have demonstrated the effectiveness of RL in improving specific aspects of visual understanding. However, learning and integrating complementary visual understanding capabilities across heterogeneous multimodal tasks remains a fundamental challenge in multimodal post-training ( Wei et al., 2026 ) .

blocks.en: A straightforward approach to enhancing VLM capabilities is to jointly optimize a shared policy over diverse multimodal training data ( Ma et al., 2025 ; Jiang et al., 2026 ; Cai et al., 2026 ) . However, heterogeneous training objectives can induce conflicts between capability-specific gradients, making it difficult for a single policy to simultaneously acquire specialized capabilities ( Yu et al., 2020 ; Liu et al., 2021 ) . To mitigate such conflicts, recent studies instead optimize capability-specific experts independently and subsequently consolidate their acquired knowledge through knowledge distillation. In particular, On-Policy Distillation (OPD) transfers knowledge by matching teacher predictions along student-generated trajectories ( Agarwal et al., 2024 ; Yuan et al., 2026 ) , while Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (MOPD) extends this paradigm to multiple capability-specific teachers, enabling a shared policy to integrate complementary capabilities from different experts ( Ma et al., 2026 ; Xiao et al., 2026 ) . Nevertheless, directly aligning the predictions of expert policies does not explicitly distinguish reusable capability-level strategies from capability-specific patterns, which may include overfitting and reward-hacking behaviors inadvertently encoded in these experts.

blocks.en:
To address these challenges, we introduce S kill-De C oupled O n- P olicy E xpert D istillation ( SCOPED ), a framework that decouples capability-specific skills from expert policies to better guide multimodal post-training. First, SCOPED independently optimizes a set of capability-specific experts with RL, where each expert is trained on a dedicated dataset with a capability-level reward objective. This independent optimization allows different experts to explore diverse solution strategies for their respective visual understanding capabilities without interference from heterogeneous training objectives.
Next, to acquire complementary visual understanding capabilities, SCOPED extracts capability-specific skills from the reasoning trajectories of these experts. These skills explicitly summarize reusable solution patterns underlying successful and failed expert behaviors. We then augment each expert with its corresponding skill to provide explicit procedural guidance during reasoning, thereby reducing unnecessary or capability-irrelevant reasoning patterns that may interfere with capability learning. Finally, SCOPED applies On-Policy Distillation (OPD) to transfer the complementary capabilities from these skill-augmented experts into a unified student model.

其次,为了获得互补的视觉理解能力,SCOPED从这些专家的推理轨迹中提取出能力特有的技能. 这些技能明确总结了专家成功和失败行为背后的可重复使用的解决方案模式. 然后,我们以相应的技能增加每位专家在推理过程中提供明确的程序指导,从而减少可能干扰能力学习的不必要的或与能力无关的推理模式。 最后,SCOPED运用On-Political Distruction(OPD)将这些技能高超的专家的补充能力转移到统一的学生模式.

blocks.en: Extensive experiments across eight multimodal benchmarks show that SCOPED enables a compact 8B model to achieve the highest average score among the evaluated models, surpassing larger open-source and leading closed-source baselines. Ablation studies demonstrate the benefits of expert distillation and the additional contribution of skill augmentation. Further analyses reveal limitations of mixed-capability optimization, including lower training rewards than independent capability RL, weak alignment with expert-guided directions, and recurring conflicts between capability-specific gradients. We also find that skill conditioning increases trajectory consistency within each capability and directs greater attention toward task-relevant visual evidence, while the distilled student better preserves expert-induced behavior.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become an effective paradigm for specializing Vision-Language Models (VLMs) under capability-specific objectives ( Liu et al., 2026b ; Xia et al., 2025 ; Peng et al., 2026 ) . By optimizing targeted reward signals, capability-specific RL enables models to focus on the visual understanding and reasoning behaviors required by a particular capability, thereby developing specialized expertise ( Xiong et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Peng et al., 2025 ) . To broaden capability coverage, recent efforts have explored jointly training a shared policy across heterogeneous capabilities ( Ma et al., 2025 ; Sarch et al., 2026 ) . However, heterogeneous objectives can induce competing gradient signals over shared parameters, causing updates beneficial to one capability to distract the optimization direction of others ( Yu et al., 2020 ; Liu et al., 2021 ) . As a result, joint optimization may restrict specialized expertise, highlighting the difficulty of simultaneously developing and consolidating heterogeneous capabilities within a unified policy.
blocks.zh: 强化学习(RL)已成为在能力具体目标(刘等,2026年b;夏等,2025年;彭等,2026年)下专门制定远景-语言模型(VLM)的有效范例. 通过优化有针对性的奖励信号,能力特定的RL使模型能够专注于特定能力所需的视觉理解和推理行为,从而发展出专业知识(Xiong等,2026;Zhang等,2026;Peng等,2025.). 为了扩大能力覆盖面,最近的努力探索了共同培训不同能力的共同政策(Ma等,2025;Sarch等,2026)。 然而,不同的目标可能会诱发相互竞争的梯度信号而超越共同参数,从而导致对一种能力有利的更新,以分散他人的优化方向(Yu等人,2020年;Liu等人,2021年)。 因此,联合优化可能限制专业知识,突出显示在统一政策中同时发展和整合不同能力的困难。

blocks.en: Rather than jointly optimizing a shared policy, knowledge distillation provides an alternative route for consolidating specialized capabilities into a unified model. On-policy distillation aligns teacher supervision with student-generated trajectories, effectively mitigating distribution shift ( Agarwal et al., 2024 ; Gu et al., 2024 ) . Recent context-conditioned variants further enrich teacher supervision with privileged information or auxiliary context ( Zhao et al., 2026 ; Ye et al., 2026 ; Yuan et al., 2026 ) . For capability integration, Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (MOPD) extends this paradigm to multiple independently optimized experts, distilling their complementary capabilities into a shared student along student-generated rollouts ( Ma et al., 2026 ; Xiao et al., 2026 ) . Nevertheless, these approaches primarily transfer expert knowledge through predictive distributions, leaving reusable reasoning patterns contained in expert trajectories largely implicit and potentially propagating noisy or over-specialized expert behaviors to the student.
blocks.zh: 知识分解不是共同优化共享政策,而是为将专门能力整合为统一模式提供替代途径。 政策上分馏使教师监督与学生产生的轨迹相协调,有效缓解了分配转移(Agarwal等,2024;Gu等,2024). 近代上下文条件变体以特权信息或辅助上下文来进一步丰富教师监管(赵等,2026;叶等,2026;袁等,2026. 对于能力整合,多教师政策分解(MOPD)将这一模式推广到多个独立优化的专家,在学生产生的推广过程中将其互补能力提炼成一个共同的学生(Ma等,2026;Xiao等,2026)。 然而,这些方法主要通过预测分布来传递专家知识,使专家轨迹中包含的可重复使用的推理模式在很大程度上是隐含的并有可能向学生传播吵闹或过于专业化的专家行为.

blocks.en: To externalize such implicit trajectory-level knowledge, recent studies have explored abstracting raw execution experiences into explicit skills that capture reusable solution patterns ( Xin et al., 2026 ) . Trace2Skill consolidates execution trajectories into transferable skills through hierarchical consolidation ( Ni et al., 2026 ) , while SkillRL and Skill1 construct evolving skill libraries to support skill retrieval and policy improvement ( Xia et al., 2026 ; Shi et al., 2026 ) . In multimodal reasoning, Lang2Act extracts self-emergent linguistic tools from reasoning trajectories to guide fine-grained visual understanding ( Xiong et al., 2026 ) . Skill-SD further conditions the teacher on trajectory-derived skills as privileged information during self-distillation ( Wang et al., 2026 ) . Together, these studies show that trajectory-derived skills can convert implicit execution experience into explicit and reusable guidance for subsequent model optimization. While these studies demonstrate the value of trajectory-derived skills for reusable reasoning and structured supervision, how such skills can regularize supervision from multiple independently optimized capability experts during their integration into a unified VLM remains underexplored.
blocks.zh: 为了将这种隐含的轨迹层面知识外部化,最近的研究探索了将原始执行经验抽象为能够捕捉可再用解决方案模式的明确技能(Xin等,2026年)。 跟踪2 Skill通过分级整合将执行轨迹整合为可转移技能(Ni等,2026年),而SkillRL和Skill1则构建了不断发展的技能库,以支持技能检索和政策改进(Xia等,2026年;Shi等,2026年). 在多模式推理中,Lang2Act从推理轨迹中提取出自激语言工具来指导精细的视觉理解(Xiong等,2026. Skill-SD进一步使教师在自我消化过程中掌握了轨迹技术作为特殊信息的条件(Wang等,2026年)。 这些研究表明,从轨迹衍生出的技能可以将隐含的行刑经验转化为明确的可再用的指导,用于后续的模型优化. 虽然这些研究显示了可重复使用的推理和结构化监督的轨迹衍生技能的价值,但这种技能如何在将多个独立优化的能力专家纳入统一的虚拟LM的过程中使其监督正规化,仍然没有得到充分探讨。

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: In this section, we present Skill-Decoupled On-Policy Expert Distillation (SCOPED), a framework for acquiring and transferring a diverse set of complementary visual understanding capabilities. As illustrated in Fig. 1 , SCOPED consists of two stages. First, we independently train MLLMs on different capabilities with capability-specific reward signals, allowing each model to develop expertise specialized to its target visual understanding capability (Sec. 3.1 ). Second, to bypass the instability of joint optimization, we abstract reward-evaluated expert trajectories into explicit skills, introducing a structural information asymmetry during on-policy distillation (Sec. 3.2 ). Serving as privileged directional anchors, these skills regularize expert supervision, compelling the student to internalize this guidance for conflict-free consolidation.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们介绍技能十足的政策问题专家消遣(SCOPED),这是一个获取和转让各种互补视觉理解能力的框架。 如图1所示,SCOPED由两个阶段组成。 首先,我们独立地对MLLMs进行不同能力的培训,并带有特定能力奖励信号,使每个模型能够发展专门技能,使其具有目标视觉理解能力(第3.1节)。 第二,为避免联合优化的不稳定性,我们把受奖励的专家轨迹抽象为明确的技能,在政策分解期间引入结构信息不对称(第3.2条)。 这些技能作为具有特殊指导地位的锚地,使专家监督正规化,迫使学生将这一指南内部化,以便无冲突地巩固。

blocks.en: 3.1 Learning MLLM Expertise with Capability-Specific Reinforcement
blocks.zh: 3.1 学习MLLM 具有特定能力强化的专门知识

blocks.en: While jointly learning diverse capabilities is essential for general visual understanding, optimizing a shared policy over heterogeneous data can introduce conflicting optimization signals and distract the learning process ( Yu et al., 2020 ; Gao et al., 2026 ) . As a result, improvements in one capability may interfere with the acquisition of another. To mitigate such interference, SCOPED decouples capability learning through independent reinforcement learning, producing specialized capability experts together with reward-evaluated trajectories that capture their acquired behaviors.

blocks.en: 3.2 Unifying Capability Experts via Skill-Augmented Distillation
blocks.zh: 3.2 通过技能强化消化法统一能力专家

blocks.en: As described in Sec. 3.1 , directly distilling raw expert predictions risks propagating reward-hacking behaviors and their associated biases ( Gao et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2024 ; Helff et al., 2026 ) . To isolate reusable expertise from such behaviors, SCOPED first extracts capability-specific skills from the expert’s global trajectory repository through reward-guided reflection, contrasting successful and failed executions to identify verified solution patterns. During subsequent on-policy distillation ( Yuan et al., 2026 ; Ma et al., 2026 ) , these extracted skills serve as privileged directional guidance ( Wang et al., 2026 ) , conditioning the expert’s supervision on explicit procedural knowledge rather than directly exposing the student to potentially biased predictions. Under this structural information asymmetry, the student aligns with the skill-regularized supervision, thereby internalizing the pure expertise while mitigating the propagation of erroneous reward-driven behaviors.
blocks.zh: 如第3.1节所描述的,直接提炼原始专家的预测有传播奖励勒索行为及其相关偏见的风险(Gao等,2023;Chen等,2024;Helff等,2026)。 为了将可重复使用的专门知识从这种行为中分离出来,SCOPED首先通过奖励指导的反思,从专家的全球轨迹储存库中提取能力特定技能,对比成功和失败的处决,找出可核实的解决方案模式. 在随后的政策分解过程中(袁等,2026;马等,2026),这些被分解出的技能作为特殊的方向指导(王等,2026),将专家的监督建立在明确的程序知识上,而不是直接使学生暴露于潜在的有偏见的预测. 在这种结构信息不对称的情况下,学生配合技能规范化的监督,从而将纯专业知识内部化,同时减少错误的奖励驱动行为的传播.

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Methodology
blocks.zh: 4 实验方法

blocks.en: This section first describes the datasets, evaluation metrics, and baselines. Then, we introduce the implementation details of our experiments.
blocks.zh: 本节首先介绍数据集、评价指标和基线。 然后,我们介绍我们实验的实施细节。

blocks.en: The evaluation covers eight benchmarks across four capability groups. CountBenchQA ( Paiss et al., 2023 ) and PixMo-Count ( Deitke et al., 2025 ) are used for fine-grained perception; CC-OCR V2 ( Xu et al., 2026c ) and ChartQA ( Masry et al., 2022 ) for OCR and chart understanding; VisualPuzzles ( Song et al., 2025 ) and We-Math ( Qiao et al., 2025 ) for symbolic visual reasoning; and MUIRBench ( Wang et al., 2025a ) and MMSI-Bench ( Yang et al., 2025 ) for multi-image reasoning. For capability-specific expert training, reinforcement learning data are constructed from six public multimodal datasets, including task-relevant subsets of Orsta-Data-47K ( Ma et al., 2025 ) . Detailed dataset composition and statistics are provided in Appendix A.1 .
blocks.zh: 评价涵盖四个能力小组的8个基准。 BenchQA伯爵(Paiss等,2023年)和PixMo-Count伯爵(Deitke等,2025年)用于精细感知;CC-OCR V2(Xu等,2026年c)和ChartQA(Masry等,2022年)用于OCR和图解;VisualPizzers(Song等,2025年)和We-Math(Qiao等,2025年)用于符号视觉推理;MUIRBench(Wang等,2025年a)和MMSI-Bench(Yang等,2025年)用于多图像推理. 关于具体能力的专家培训,从六个公共多模式数据集,包括Orsta-Data-47K的任务相关子集(Ma等,2025年)中构建了强化学习数据。 详细的数据集构成和统计数据见附录A.1。

blocks.en: We employ task-specific metrics following the official evaluation protocols of each benchmark. Fine-grained perception, chart understanding, symbolic visual reasoning, and multi-image reasoning tasks are evaluated using accuracy. OCR recognition is evaluated using micro-F1 following CC-OCR V2 ( Xu et al., 2026c ) . All scores are reported as percentages, and the overall score is the arithmetic mean across the eight benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 我们按照每个基准的正式评价协议采用具体任务衡量标准。 精细的感知,图表理解,符号视觉推理,多图像推理任务都是用精度评价的. CC-OCR V2(徐等,2026c.)之后使用微F1对OCR识别进行评估. 所有分数都作为百分比报告,总分是8个基准的算术平均值。

blocks.en: In our experiments, we compare SCOPED with representative closed-source and open-source vision-language models. The closed-source baselines include Claude Sonnet 4.6 and Claude Opus 4.6 ( Anthropic, 2026b ; Anthropic, 2026a ) , GPT-5.2 ( OpenAI, 2025 ) , and GPT-5.4 ( OpenAI, 2026 ) . The open-source baselines include GLM-4.1V-9B-Base ( Hong et al., 2025 ) , Qwen2.5-VL-7B ( Bai et al., 2025b ) , InternVL3.5-8B ( Wang et al., 2025b ) , Qwen3-VL-8B and Qwen3-VL-32B ( Bai et al., 2025a ) , and MiMo-VL-7B-RL ( Xiaomi LLM-Core Team, 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 在我们的实验中,我们比较了SCOPED与有代表性的闭源和开源视觉语言模型. 封闭源基线包括克洛德·索内 4.6和克洛德·奥普斯 4.6(Anthropic, 2026b;Anthropic, 2026a.),GPT-5.2(OpenAI, 2025)和GPT-5.4(OpenAI, 2026. 开源基线包括:GLM-4.1V-9B-Base(Hong等,2025年),Qun2.5-VL-7B(Bai等,2025年b),InternVL3.5-8B(Wang等,2025年b),Qun3-VL-8B和Qun3-VL-32B(Bai等,2025年a),和MiMo-VL-7B-RL(Xiaomi LLM-Core Team,2025年).

blocks.en: In our experiments, we employ Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct and Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct ( Bai et al., 2025a ) as the shared backbone to construct all capability-specialized experts and the unified student. Capability-specific reinforcement learning is implemented with EasyR1 ( Zheng et al., 2025 ) , and multi-expert on-policy distillation is implemented with veRL ( Sheng et al., 2024 ) . All experiments are conducted on NVIDIA A800 GPUs. More training implementation details and hyperparameter settings are presented in Appendix A.2 .
blocks.zh: 在我们的实验中,我们利用了Qune3-VL-8B-Instruct和Qune3-VL-4B-Instruct(Bai等,2025a)作为共同的骨干,构建出所有能力专业专家和统一的学生. EasyR1(郑等,2025年)实施能力特异性强化学习,VERL(沈等,2024年)实施多专家政策分解. 所有实验都是在NVIDIA A800 GPU上进行的. 附录A.2列出了更多的培训实施细节和超参数设置。

blocks.en: 5 Results and Analysis
blocks.zh: 5 结果和分析

blocks.en: In this section, we first evaluate the overall performance of SCOPED across eight multimodal benchmarks and conduct ablation studies to assess the effectiveness of its key components. We then provide in-depth analyses of cross-capability gradient interference under mixed-capability optimization and investigate how skill augmentation influences expert supervision during capability integration.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们首先评价《标准经济、社会、文化权利国际公约》在八项多式基准中的总体业绩,并进行开发研究,以评估其关键组成部分的有效性。 然后,我们深入分析混合能力优化下的跨能力梯度干扰,并调查技能增强如何影响能力整合期间的专家监督。

blocks.en: 5.1 Overall Performance
blocks.zh: 5.1 总体业绩

blocks.en:

blocks.en: As shown in Table 1 , we report the performance of various VLMs across eight benchmarks. The evaluation results show that SCOPED consistently improves the Qwen3-VL backbone across heterogeneous visual understanding capabilities. In particular, SCOPED-8B outperforms its backbone on all eight benchmarks, achieving an average improvement of 5.83 points. These results demonstrate that our framework can effectively consolidate complementary capabilities into a unified model.
blocks.zh: 如表1所显示的,我们报告各种自愿活动在8个基准上的绩效。 评价结果显示,SCOPED在各种视觉理解能力方面不断改进了Quen3-VL主干线。 特别是,SCOPED-8B在所有8个基准上都超过了它的骨干,平均提高了5.83分. 这些结果表明,我们的框架能够有效地将互补能力合并为一个统一模式。

blocks.en:
Compared with existing open-source and closed-source models, SCOPED-8B achieves the best overall performance among the evaluated models and further surpasses the substantially larger model Qwen3-VL-32B, demonstrating that effective capability integration can yield substantial gains without simply scaling up the model.
We adopt Qwen3-VL as the backbone due to its competitive performance across the evaluated capability groups. Nevertheless, existing models often exhibit uneven performance across different capabilities, making it challenging to simultaneously maintain strong performance in perception, OCR and chart understanding, symbolic reasoning, and multi-image reasoning.
In contrast, SCOPED consistently strengthens the backbone across all four capability groups.
We further apply SCOPED to Qwen3-VL-4B, where it achieves an average improvement of 3.90 points and surpasses several larger open-source models. The consistent gains observed with both the 4B and 8B backbones demonstrate that the effectiveness of SCOPED generalizes across model scales and remains robust across diverse visual capabilities.
blocks.zh:
与现有的开源和闭源模型相比,SCOPED-8B在被评价模型中实现了最佳的整体性能,并进一步超越了大得多的Qwen3-VL-32B模型,表明有效的能力整合可以产生巨大的收益而无需简单地扩大模型.
我们采用 " Qune3-VL " 作为骨干,因为它在被评价的能力团体中具有竞争力。 尽管如此,现有模型在不同能力之间往往表现出不均匀的性能,因此很难同时在认知、OCR和图表理解、象征性推理和多图像推理方面保持强效性能。
相比之下,SCOPED始终加强所有四个能力组的骨干力量。
我们进一步将 SCOPED 应用到 Qune3-VL-4B 中,它实现了平均3.90分的改进并超过了几个更大的开源模型. 在4B和8B主干线上观察到的一致进展表明,SCOPED的有效性在模型尺度上得到概括,在不同的视觉能力上仍然很强。

blocks.en: As shown in Table 2 , we conduct ablation studies to investigate the effectiveness of different multi-task training strategies and the individual components of SCOPED. We first compare SCOPED with SFT and Mix-RL to assess the benefits of our training paradigm. We then ablate key components of SCOPED to examine their respective contributions. For reference, we also report the performance of capability-specific experts, each of which is optimized exclusively with task-specific rewards.
blocks.zh: 如表2所示,我们进行了减税研究,以调查不同多任务培训战略的有效性以及SCOPED的各个组成部分。 我们首先将SCOPED与SFT和Mix-RL进行比较,以评估我们的培训模式的好处。 然后,我们放弃了SCOPED的关键组成部分,以审查它们各自的贡献。 我们还报告具体能力专家的业绩,每个专家都只得到特定任务的奖励。

blocks.en: The evaluation results show that SFT underperforms the zero-shot backbone, suggesting that jointly fine-tuning on capability-specific data can introduce interference across capabilities. Although Mix-RL improves overall performance, it still underperforms the corresponding specialized experts on symbolic visual reasoning and multi-image reasoning, indicating that joint optimization may limit the acquisition of specialized capabilities. In contrast, SCOPED achieves an average improvement of 3.82 points over Mix-RL, demonstrating the effectiveness of separating capability acquisition from capability integration. The skill-augmented expert results further show that matching each expert with its corresponding skill consistently improves the target capability, while its effects on non-target capabilities are limited and occasionally negative. This result highlights the capability-specific nature of the extracted guidance and motivates explicit skill-expert matching during distillation.
blocks.zh: 评价结果显示,SFT在零射入主干线上表现不佳,这表明联合微调特定能力数据可以引入跨能力的干扰. 虽然Mix-RL提高了整体性能,但它在象征性视觉推理和多图像推理方面仍然表现不佳,表明联合优化可能会限制获得专门能力. 相形之下,SCOPED比Mix-RL平均提高3.82分,显示了将能力获取与能力整合分开的效果. 提高技能的专家结果进一步表明,使每位专家与其相应技能相匹配,能够不断提高目标能力,而其对非目标能力的影响是有限的,有时是负面的。 这一结果凸显出所取取取的取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取

blocks.en: Furthermore, we compare two variants of SCOPED, SCOPED (Parameter Merging) and SCOPED w/o Skill Augmentation, which use parameter merging and distillation without skill augmentation, respectively, to unify multiple capability-specific experts into a single model. SCOPED (Parameter Merging) consistently underperforms the on-policy distillation variants, suggesting that directly merging expert parameters is insufficient to fully integrate complementary capabilities. In contrast, SCOPED w/o Skill Augmentation already outperforms Mix-RL, indicating that token-level supervision from the corresponding experts along student-generated trajectories provides more fine-grained guidance for learning different capabilities. This allows the unified model to progressively absorb expertise that was independently acquired by the specialized experts. Building on this foundation, the full SCOPED framework achieves a further average improvement, with gains across all four capability groups. These results indicate that explicit skills extracted from expert experience provide more targeted distillation signals, facilitating specialized capability distillation.
blocks.zh: 此外,我们比较了SCOPED的两个变体:SCOPED(Parameter Merging)和SCOPED w/o 技能增强(SCOPED w/o Skill Advancement),它们分别使用参数合并和分馏而无需技能增强,将多个能力特定专家统一为一个单一模型. SCOPED (Paremeter Merging) 政策提炼变式的表现一直不佳,这表明直接合并专家参数不足以充分整合互补能力。 相比之下,SCOPED w/o 技能增强已经超越了Mix-RL,表明相应专家在学生所生成的轨迹上的象征性监督为学习不同能力提供了更精细的指导. 这使统一模式能够逐步吸收专业专家独立获得的专门知识。 在这个基础上,整个SCOPED框架取得了进一步的平均改善,所有四个能力小组都取得了进展。 这些结果表明,从专家经验中获取的明确技能提供了更有针对性的蒸馏信号,促进了专门的能力蒸馏。

blocks.en: 5.3 Gradient Interference in Multi-Capability Training
blocks.zh: 5.3 多能力培训的渐进干扰

blocks.en: As illustrated in Figure 2 , we investigate the cross-capability gradient interference phenomenon ( Yu et al., 2020 ; Liu et al., 2021 ) during shared-policy optimization from three complementary perspectives: training reward, expert-guided update alignment, and pairwise gradient conflict.
blocks.zh: 如图2所示,我们在共享政策优化期间从三个互补角度调查跨能力梯度干扰现象(Yu等,2020;Liu等,2021)。

blocks.en: (a) Training Reward.
blocks.zh: (a) 培训奖励。

blocks.zh: (b) Mix-RL模型的能力更新对接。

(a) Average training reward of independent capability RL and Mix-RL.
(b) Alignment of shared Mix-RL updates with capability-specific expert directions.
(c) Pairwise gradient cosine similarity across Mix-RL training stages.
blocks.zh:
图2:跨能力 Mix-RL干扰.
(a) 独立能力RL和Mix-RL的平均培训奖励。
(b) 使共享的Mix-RL更新与针对具体能力的专家指导保持一致。
(c) Mix-RL培训阶段的对等梯度同位素相似性。

blocks.en:
We first evaluate the training dynamics in Figure 2(a) . While both independent capability RL and Mix-RL steadily improve their average rewards, independent optimization maintains a consistent advantage throughout most of the training process.
Although the performance gap narrows toward convergence, the overall trend clearly indicates that mixed-capability optimization structurally limits the gains achievable through capability-specific learning, preventing the model from fully benefiting from independently optimized capability objectives. To uncover the mechanistic cause of this limitation, we analyze how the realized Mix-RL updates align with the behaviors acquired by independently trained capability experts. We characterize this parameter-space update alignment using cosine similarity ( Xu et al., 2026b ) . Specifically, for each capability, we derive a local expert-guided direction from the negative gradient of the KL divergence between the current Mix-RL policy and the corresponding fixed capability expert under matched response prefixes. We then compute its cosine similarity against the actual parameter displacement between adjacent Mix-RL checkpoints. In this formulation, positive values denote movement toward the expert, whereas near-zero or negative values indicate orthogonal or contradictory updates. As shown in Figure 2(b) , the shared updates show weak alignment with the expert-guided directions, with negative values observed across multiple capabilities and training stages. This confirms a severe see-saw effect: shared-policy optimization inevitably forces trade-offs, improving certain capabilities at the direct expense of others rather than consistently approximating all capability-specific experts simultaneously.
blocks.zh:
我们首先在图2(a)中评估培训动态。 虽然独立能力RL和Mix-RL都稳步提高平均回报,但在整个大多数培训过程中,独立优化保持了一贯的优势。
虽然业绩差距缩小到趋同,但总体趋势清楚地表明,混合能力优化在结构上限制了通过能力特定学习而实现的收益,使模型无法从独立优化的能力目标中充分受益。 为了发现这种限制的机械原因,我们分析实现的Mix-RL更新如何与受过独立训练的能力专家获得的行为一致. 我们使用相弦相似性来描述这个参数-空间更新对齐(Xu等,2026b.). 具体而言,对于每种能力,我们从当前Mix-RL政策和相应固定能力专家在对应响应前缀下KL相差的负梯度得出一个当地专家指导方向。 然后根据相邻的Mix-RL检查站之间的实际参数迁移来计算其同位素相似性。 在这一公式中,正值表示向专家移动,而近零或负值表示正向或自相矛盾的更新。 如图2(b)所示,共享的更新显示,与专家指导方向的配合薄弱,在多个能力和培训阶段观察到负值。 这证实了一种严重的锯锯效应:共享政策优化不可避免地迫使取舍取舍,直接牺牲他人而改进某些能力,而不是始终同时接近所有具体能力的专家。

blocks.en: This interference is further supported by analyzing the capability-specific optimization directions themselves. At each Mix-RL checkpoint, we estimate capability-specific gradients using the corresponding capability data and compute pairwise cosine similarities among the four capabilities ( Yu et al., 2020 ; Liu et al., 2021 ) . Positive cosine similarity indicates aligned optimization directions, whereas negative values indicate that two capabilities favor opposing local updates. Figure 2(c) reveals recurrent negative cosine similarities across multiple capability pairs at different training stages, providing direct empirical evidence that heterogeneous capabilities can favor competing local optimization directions. Together, these results demonstrate that shared-policy optimization is constrained by cross-capability interference. These results further support the motivation of SCOPED to decouple capability acquisition into independently optimized experts prior to subsequent integration.
blocks.zh: 这种干扰通过分析能力特定优化方向本身得到进一步支持。 在每个Mix-RL检查点,我们利用相应的能力数据估算能力特定梯度,并计算出四种能力之间的对等余弦相似性(Yu等,2020;Liu等,2021)。 正同位素相似性表示对齐优化方向,而负值则表示两种能力倾向于反对局部更新. 图2(c)显示,在不同培训阶段,多种能力对之间经常出现负同位素相似之处,提供了直接的经验证据,表明各种能力有利于相互竞争的地方优化方向。 这些结果共同表明,共享政策优化受到跨能力干预的制约。 这些结果进一步支持了SCOPED在随后整合之前将能力获取分解为独立优化的专家的动机.

blocks.en: 5.4 Effectiveness of Skill-Augmented Distillation in SCOPED
blocks.zh: 5.4 SCOPED技术强化消化的有效性

blocks.en: In this section, we further investigate how skill augmentation regularizes expert supervision during the distillation process of SCOPED. As illustrated in Figure 3 , we examine its effects from three complementary perspectives: the preservation of expert-induced behavior in the unified student, the consistency of expert trajectories across instances within each capability, and the utilization of task-relevant visual evidence.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们进一步调查技能增强如何在SCOPED蒸馏过程中使专家监督规范化。 如图3所示,我们从三个互补角度审视其效果:在统一的学生中保留由专家引起的行为、在每种能力范围内专家的轨迹的一致性以及利用与任务有关的视觉证据。

blocks.en: We first characterize functional capability preservation using token-level log-probability shifts relative to the base model on fixed trajectories ( Klabunde et al., 2025 ) . For each trajectory, we construct a shift vector from these log-probability changes and compare the unified student with the corresponding expert in terms of amplitude retention and expert alignment. Amplitude retention quantifies how much of the expert-induced shift is preserved by the student, while expert alignment measures the cosine similarity between their shift vectors. We evaluate models distilled from different capability-specific RL experts across visual understanding capabilities. As shown in Figure 3(a) , SCOPED achieves higher amplitude retention and expert alignment than Mix-RL, demonstrating better preservation of expert-induced functional behavior across capabilities. Notably, SCOPED also outperforms SCOPED w/o Skill Augmentation, indicating that the extracted skills help the student better acquire and reconcile complementary expert capabilities.
blocks.zh: 我们首先利用与固定轨迹基准模型相对的符号级对数概率变化来描述功能能力保存(Klabunde等,2025年)。 对于每个轨迹,我们从这些对数概率变化中构建出一个转向向量,并在振幅保持和专家对接方面将统一的学生与相应的专家进行比较. 振幅保留可以量化专家所引发的转向有多少由学生保留,而专家对接则测量其转向向量之间的同位素相似性. 我们评价不同能力、特定RL专家在视觉理解能力方面的模型。 如图3(a)所示,SCOPED实现比Mix-RL更高的振幅保留和专家对接,表明更好地保存了专家引发的跨能力功能行为. 值得注意的是,SCOPED的成绩也超过了SCOPED w/o 技能提升,表明提取出的技能帮助学生更好地获得并调和互补的专家能力.

blocks.en:
To further uncover the role of skill augmentation in SCOPED, we evaluate the consistency of expert generation by encoding reasoning trajectories produced by each capability expert with and without its corresponding skill using Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B ( Li et al., 2026 ) . Within each capability, we compute pairwise cosine similarities between trajectory embeddings generated from different inputs to obtain the distributions shown in Figure 3(b) . Higher similarity indicates more consistent expert behavior across instances. With skill conditioning, SCOPED shifts the trajectory similarity distribution toward higher values, indicating that explicit skill guidance regularizes expert generation and promotes more consistent trajectory representations.
Finally, we investigate whether this trajectory-level regularization extends to visual evidence utilization. Building on findings that attention patterns in VLMs can effectively capture task-relevant visual grounding ( Kang et al., 2025 ) , we compare each capability expert with and without its corresponding skill under identical inputs. At each decoder layer, we identify the most-attended visual token for each attention head and record a hit if it falls within the task-relevant region. We then average the resulting hit rates across attention heads and evaluation samples. As shown in Figure 3(c) , skill-augmented experts consistently achieve higher hit rates across most of the upper decoder layers, with the largest improvement observed in the final layer. This finding indicates that explicit skills steer capability experts toward more accurate allocation of attention to task-relevant visual evidence. Taken together, these multi-level analyses suggest that skill conditioning promotes more consistent expert trajectories and more effective visual grounding, while enabling the distilled student to better preserve expert-induced functional behavior.
blocks.zh:
为了进一步发现技能增强在SCOPED中的作用,我们利用Qune3-VL-Embedding-2B(Li等,2026年),通过编码每个能力专家无论有无相应技能所产生的推理轨迹,评价专家生成的一致性。 在每种能力范围内,我们计算出不同输入所生成的轨迹嵌入的相容性,以获得图3(b)所显示的分布。 高度相似性表明,不同情况下的专家行为更加一致。 随着技能的调整,SCOPED将轨迹相似性分布转向更高的价值,表明明确的技能指导使专家生成规范化,并促进更一致的轨迹表述.
最后,我们调查这种轨迹水平的正规化是否延伸到视觉证据的利用。 根据关于VLM的注意模式可以有效捕捉与任务相关的视觉地基的结论(Kang等人,2025年),我们比较了每个能力专家在相同投入下是否具有相应的技能。 在每个解码层,我们确定每个注意头最受关注的视觉标志,并记录一个被击中的,如果它属于与任务相关的区域。 然后,我们平均得出各个关注点和评价样本的命中率。 如图3(c)所显示,技能增强型专家在大多数上层解码器的打击率一直较高,最后一层的改进最大。 这一结论表明,明确的技能引导能力专家更准确地关注与任务有关的视觉证据。 这些多层次的分析表明,技能调节可以促进更一致的专家轨迹和更有效的视觉地平面,同时使被蒸馏的学生能够更好地保存由专家引起的功能行为.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: This paper proposes SCOPED, aiming at integrating complementary visual understanding capabilities into a unified Vision-Language Model through skill-decoupled on-policy expert distillation. SCOPED independently optimizes capability-specific experts and abstracts reusable solution patterns from reward-evaluated trajectories into explicit capability skills. During on-policy distillation, these skills guide capability experts to provide structured supervision for the unified student. Our experiments demonstrate that SCOPED consistently improves performance across diverse visual understanding capabilities. Our further analyses reveal cross-capability interference during mixed-capability optimization and show that skill augmentation improves the preservation and transfer of specialized expert capabilities.
blocks.zh: 本文提出SCOPED,目的是通过技术脱钩的政策专家提炼,将互补的视觉理解能力纳入统一的远景-语言模型。 SCOPED独立优化了能力特有专家,并总结了可重复使用的解决方案模式,从奖励评价的轨迹转变为明确的能力技能. 在政策提炼期间,这些技能指导能力专家为统一学生提供结构化监督. 我们的实验表明,SCOPED不断提高不同视觉理解能力的性能. 我们的进一步分析表明,混合能力优化期间的跨能力干扰表明,技能增强可改进专业专家能力的保存和转让。

blocks.en: We design task-specific automatic rewards to accommodate the heterogeneous output spaces of the training tasks. blocks.en: A.4 Additional Ablation on Model Scale
blocks.zh: A.4 模型尺度的补充考虑

blocks.en: Table 6: Ablation Study. All models are built on Qwen3-VL-4B. We compare training and capability integration strategies, with capability-specific experts shown as references for assessing expertise retention. The best and second-best results are highlighted in bold and underlined , respectively.
blocks.zh: 表6:发育研究。 所有型号都以Quen3-VL-4B为基础. 我们比较了培训和能力整合战略,并将具体能力专家作为评估专门知识保留情况的参考。 最佳和次好结果分别以粗体和下划线突出。

blocks.en: We further conduct the same ablation study on Qwen3-VL-4B to examine whether the effectiveness of our design remains consistent at a smaller model scale. As shown in Table 6 , SFT substantially underperforms the zero-shot backbone, while Mix-RL yields only a modest overall improvement and remains below the corresponding capability-specific experts on several target capabilities. In contrast, independently trained experts achieve stronger performance on their respective capabilities, showing that the benefit of separating capability acquisition from integration remains evident with a smaller backbone.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步对Qune3-VL-4B进行同样的消化研究,以审查我们的设计效果在较小的模型规模上是否保持一致. 如表6所显示的,SFT在零射入中的主干线上表现严重不足,而Mix-RL在整体上只取得微小的改进,在几个目标能力上仍然低于相应的特定能力专家. 相比之下,受过独立培训的专家在各自能力方面表现得更佳,表明将能力获取与整合区分开来的好处仍然明显,骨干力量较小。

blocks.en: The skill-augmented expert results exhibit a trend consistent with Qwen3-VL-8B. Conditioning each expert on its matched skill improves performance on the corresponding target capability, while the effects on non-target capabilities remain limited or mixed. This further supports the capability-specific nature of the extracted guidance and the use of explicit skill-expert matching during distillation.
blocks.zh: 技能提升的专家成果呈现出与Qune3-VL-8B一致的趋势。 使每位专家具备相应技能,可提高相应目标能力的绩效,而对非目标能力的影响仍然有限或有好有坏。 这进一步支持了所提取的指南的能力特性,以及在蒸馏过程中使用明确的技能专家匹配。

blocks.en: For capability integration, we compare SCOPED (Parameter Merging), SCOPED w/o Skill Augmentation, and the full SCOPED framework using the same capability-specific experts. SCOPED w/o Skill Augmentation outperforms parameter merging, showing that on-policy expert supervision provides a more effective mechanism for transferring independently acquired capabilities than direct parameter-space merging. Incorporating skill augmentation further improves the unified model, yielding the best average performance among the compared integration variants. Together with the Qwen3-VL-8B results, these consistent trends indicate that the effectiveness of SCOPED is not restricted to a particular backbone scale.
blocks.zh: 关于能力整合,我们利用相同的能力专家,比较了SCOPED(Paremeter Merging)、SCOPED w/o 技能增强,以及SCOPED的全部框架。 SCOPED w/o 技能增强比参数合并的绩效要好,这表明政策专家监督为独立转移获得的能力提供了比直接参数-空间合并更有效的机制. 纳入技能增强可进一步改善统一模式,使比较的整合变体的平均业绩最佳。 加上Qune3-VL-8B结果,这些一致的趋势表明,SCOPED的有效性并不限于特定的骨干尺度.

blocks.en: A.5 Skill Construction Details
blocks.zh: A.5 技术建设细节

blocks.en: We provide additional implementation details for the capability-wise skill abstraction procedure introduced in Sec. 3.2 . Skill construction uses only training data and training-set rollouts, while the held-out evaluation set is used exclusively for final evaluation. For each capability, a single skill is constructed from the trajectories generated by its corresponding optimized expert.
blocks.zh: 我们为在Sec中引入的能力技能抽象程序提供更多的执行细节。 3.2 (英语). 技能建设只使用培训数据和确定培训内容的推出,而持有的评价套专门用于最后评价。 对于每种能力,从相应的优化专家产生的轨迹中构建出单一技能。

blocks.en: For each training instance, the optimized capability expert samples multiple rollout trajectories, each of which is evaluated by the corresponding capability-specific reward function. To reduce redundancy, we deduplicate repeated trajectories within each task subtype and balance the retained trajectories across subtypes so that high-resource tasks do not dominate the subsequent skill construction process.
blocks.zh: 对于每个培训实例,优化的能力专家对多个推出轨迹进行抽样,每个轨迹都通过相应的能力特定奖励功能进行评估. 为了减少冗余,我们将每个任务子类型内重复的轨迹调解,并平衡各子类型间所保留的轨迹,使高资源任务不会支配后续的技能构建过程.

blocks.en: Following Sec. 3.2 , the curated trajectories are divided into successful and failed cohorts according to their capability-specific rewards. This grouping provides complementary evidence about effective solution patterns and recurring failure modes.
blocks.zh: 继第3.2条之后,被曲折的轨迹根据其能力的具体奖励分为成功组和失败组. 这种分组提供了有效解决方案模式和重复故障模式的补充证据。

blocks.en: The optimized capability expert performs trajectory-level reflection over the successful and failed cohorts using outcome-specific reflection prompts. Successful trajectories are used to identify reusable solution strategies and verification behaviors, while failed trajectories are analyzed to diagnose recurring failure mechanisms and derive corrective guidance. The resulting reflections are aggregated into a capability-specific evidence ledger containing both effective behaviors and failure-avoidance guidance.
blocks.zh: 优化能力专家利用成果特异性反射提示,对成功和失败的群体进行轨迹级反射。 成功的轨迹被用于识别可再用溶液策略和验证行为,而失败的轨迹则被分析,诊断出反复发生的故障机制并获得矫正指导. 由此产生的反射被汇总成一个针对具体能力的证据分类账,包含有效行为和失败避免指导.

blocks.en: Based on the aggregated trajectory-derived evidence, the same capability expert synthesizes a single capability-level skill containing reusable procedural guidance for the corresponding capability. The resulting skill is subsequently used to condition the expert during skill-decoupled on-policy expert distillation. This procedure produces one skill for each of the four capabilities. Detailed reflection and skill-induction prompts are provided in Appendix A.12 .
blocks.zh: 根据汇总的轨迹证据,同一能力专家综合了单一的能力级技能,其中包括对相应能力可重复使用的程序指导。 由此产生的技能随后被用来在与技能脱节的政策专家提炼过程中为专家提供条件。 这一程序为四个能力中每个能力产生一个技能。 附录A.12提供了详细的思考和技能介绍提示。

blocks.en: Table 7 examines the contribution of successful and failed trajectories to skill construction. Using either successful or failed trajectories alone improves the corresponding capability experts, while combining both sources achieves the strongest overall performance. This indicates that successful solution patterns and corrective failure experience provide complementary information for capability skill abstraction.
blocks.zh: 表7审查了成功和失败的轨迹对技能建设的贡献。 仅仅使用成功或失败的轨迹可以提高相应的能力专家,同时将两种来源结合起来可以实现最强的整体性能. 这表明,成功的解决方案模式和纠正失败的经验为能力技能抽象提供了补充信息。

blocks.en: To complement the macro-averaged results presented in the main text, we further examine expert capability retention and alignment across individual capabilities. As shown in Figure 5(a) and Figure 5(b) , SCOPED consistently achieves higher amplitude retention and expert alignment across all four capabilities, demonstrating more effective preservation of specialized expert behavior.

blocks.en: To examine whether these improvements arise from capability-specific guidance rather than additional contextual information, we compare matched capability skills with randomly assigned skills. As shown in Figure 5(c) , most samples lie above the diagonal, indicating that matched skills induce functional changes more closely aligned with the corresponding expert directions than random skills. These results suggest that the extracted skills provide targeted guidance consistent with capability-specific expertise.
blocks.zh: 为了审查这些改进是否来自具体能力的指导,而不是额外的背景信息,我们将能力技能与随机分配的技能进行比较。 如图5(c)所示,大多数样本位于对角上方,表明相匹配的技能比随机技能更能诱发与相应专家方向更紧密的功能变化. 这些结果表明,抽取的技能提供了符合具体能力专长的有针对性的指导。

blocks.en: A.11 Case Studies
blocks.zh: A.11 个案研究

blocks.en: To better understand how skill-augmented distillation changes the behavior of the unified model, we present a representative example in Figure 7 . The task requires identifying the age group with the highest percentage of Associate degrees. While SCOPED w/o Skill Augmentation follows an erroneous reasoning trajectory and predicts “25 to 34”, the full SCOPED model correctly identifies “35 to 44”.
blocks.zh: 为了更好地了解技能提升蒸馏如何改变统一模型的行为,我们在图7中举出一个有代表性的例子。 这项任务要求确定准学位百分比最高的年龄组。 虽然SCOPED w/o 技能增强运动遵循错误的推理轨迹,并预测“25至34”,但SCOPED模型全文正确确定了“35至44”。

blocks.en: The visualization further illustrates how skill-augmented supervision affects the model’s use of visual evidence and token-level predictions. Compared with SCOPED w/o Skill Augmentation, SCOPED allocates more attention to the region supporting the correct answer while reducing attention to the misleading region associated with the incorrect prediction. At the token level, SCOPED also suppresses responses along the erroneous trajectory and strengthens those supporting the correct prediction.
blocks.zh: 这种可视化进一步说明了技能强化监督如何影响模型对可视证据和信使级预测的使用。 与SCOPED w/o 技能增强相比,SCOPED更多地关注支持正确答案的区域,同时减少对与错误预测相关的误导区域的关注. 在象征性的层面上,SCOPED还压制了沿错误轨迹的反应,并加强了支持正确预测的响应.

blocks.en: This case complements the quantitative analyses in Section 5.4 , showing that skill-augmented expert supervision can lead the unified model to rely more on task-relevant visual evidence and avoid erroneous reasoning patterns during generation.
blocks.zh: 这一案例补充了第5.4节中的定量分析,表明技能强化的专家监督可以引导统一模型更多地依赖与任务相关的视觉证据,并避免在生成过程中出现错误的推理模式.

blocks.en: We further present representative examples from PixMo-Count, MUIRBench, and MMSI-Bench to examine whether these improvements are reflected across different visual capabilities. On PixMo-Count, the Qwen3-VL-Instruct backbone overlooks one aircraft and predicts six, whereas SCOPED systematically scans and verifies individual instances before correctly identifying all seven aircraft. On MUIRBench, the backbone is distracted by appearance differences between maps, while SCOPED instead compares stable structural and spatial cues and correctly identifies the corresponding image. Similarly, on MMSI-Bench, SCOPED tracks the relative displacement of persistent visual landmarks across images and correctly infers the movement direction, whereas the backbone reaches an incorrect conclusion from a coarser comparison of the scenes.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步介绍了PixMo-Count、MUIRBench和MMSI-Bench的有代表性的例子,以审查这些改进是否反映在不同的视觉能力中。 在PixMo-Count上,Qune3-VL-Instruct主干线忽略了一架飞机并预测了六架飞机,而SCOPED则系统扫描并验证个别情况,然后正确识别出所有七架飞机. 在MUIRBench上,主干被地图之间的外观差异所分心,而SCOPED则比较了稳定的结构和空间提示并正确识别了相应的图像. 同样地,在MMSI-Bench上,SCOPED跟踪了持续视觉地标在图像之间的相对位置并正确推断出运动方向,而骨干通过对场景的相近比较得出了错误的结论.

blocks.en: A.12 Prompt Examples
blocks.zh: A.12 即时实例

blocks.en: We provide the prompt templates used for both skill construction and evaluation.
blocks.zh: 我们提供了用于技能建设和评价的快速模板。

blocks.en: Our skill construction procedure uses three main prompts. First, the successful-trajectory self-reflection prompt asks the optimized capability expert to identify reusable verification behaviors and their activation conditions from its successful trajectories. Second, the failed-trajectory self-reflection prompt asks the same expert to diagnose causal failure mechanisms and derive corresponding corrective principles. Finally, the evidence-grounded skill induction prompt provides the curated evidence ledger to the same expert and asks it to consolidate recurring success and failure patterns into a compact capability-level skill. The corresponding prompt templates are shown in Figures 12 – 14 .
blocks.zh: 我们的技巧构建程序 使用了三个主要的提示。 首先,成功的弹出自反射快取要求优化能力专家从成功的轨迹中识别可再用核查行为及其活化条件. 第二,失败的弹出自反射即时要求同一位专家诊断出因果关系失败机制并得出相应的纠正原则. 最后,基于证据的技能入门提示器向同一专家提供了整理的证据分类账,并要求该分类账将反复出现的成败模式整合为紧凑的能力级技能。 相应的即时模板见图12 – 14。

blocks.en: Figure 14 presents the vanilla evaluation prompt, where the model receives the input image(s), the benchmark-specific query, and the corresponding response instruction. The model is instructed to reason step by step and place its final response within <answer> and </answer> tags. The required output format is instantiated according to the benchmark: multiple-choice tasks require the final option letter, OCR tasks follow the official per-sample recognition instructions.
blocks.zh: 图14显示了香草评价快报,模型在那里接收了输入图像,具体基准的查询,以及相应的响应指示. 该模型被指示一步一步地说明理由,并将其最后答复置于 " 答 " 和 " 答 " 标签中。 需要的输出格式按照基准进行即时化:多选择任务需要最终选项字母,OCR任务遵循官方的每个样本识别指示.

blocks.en: For evaluating skill-augmented capability experts in the ablation and analysis experiments, we preserve the original multimodal input and response instruction and condition each expert on its corresponding capability skill. The four extracted skills correspond to perception, OCR and chart understanding, symbolic reasoning, and multi-image reasoning, respectively. The unified student does not receive explicit skill conditioning during inference.
blocks.zh: 为了评价在开发和分析实验中掌握技能的能力的专家,我们保留了最初的多式联运投入和反应指示,并对每位专家的相应能力技能设置条件。 所摘取的四种技能分别对应了感知,OCR和图表理解,符号推理,和多图像推理. 统一的学生在推论中没有得到明确的技能调节.

blocks.en: Apply ONLY the task section matching the current question type; ignore the others.
blocks.zh: 只应用匹配当前问题类型的任务部分;忽略其它问题。

blocks.en: When the task involves sequential operations, update the working state after each step before proceeding.
blocks.zh: 当任务涉及相继操作时,在进行前每一步后更新工作状态.

blocks.en: Do not use dataset names, filenames, memorized examples, or external information.
blocks.zh: 不要使用数据集名称、文件名、被记住的例子或外部信息。

blocks.en: When a candidate instance is faint, translucent, partially cropped at the image edge, or only a tiny fragment is visible, exclude it from the count—only count objects that are clearly and substantially present.
blocks.zh: 当一个候选实例被晕倒、半透明、部分被割到图像边缘,或者只看到一个很小的碎片时,就将其排除在计数之外——只有明显和实质性存在的计数物体。

blocks.en: When the noun could refer to either a complete assembled item or its sub-components, count the most natural standalone unit that the noun refers to in everyday language.
blocks.zh: 当名词可以指代一个完整的组装项目或其子组件时,会数到名词在日常语言中指的最自然的独立单位.

blocks.en: When the task involved subtraction or modification, confirm the final result reflects all operations applied in order.
blocks.zh: 当任务涉及去除或修改时,确认最终结果反映按顺序应用的所有操作.

blocks.en: When your count includes a faint, translucent, or barely visible instance and you are uncertain, re-examine whether that instance is real before including it.
blocks.zh: 当你的计数包括一个微弱,半透明,或者几乎不显眼的例子,而你不确定时,重新审视这个例子是否真实,然后才将其列入.

blocks.en: When counting in a natural photograph, recount the entire scene after your first read—the dominant error is omission of partially hidden or edge-proximal instances.
blocks.zh: 在自然相片中计数时, 在您第一次阅读后重新描述整个场景—— 最主要的错误是忽略了部分隐藏或边缘近似的情况 。

blocks.en: When spatial density or layout ambiguity arises, check for hidden or partial objects—include partially visible objects if context and boundaries support that they are real instances.
blocks.zh: 当出现空间密度或布局模糊时,检查隐藏或部分物体——如果上下文和边界支持它们是真实的例子,则包括部分可见物体。

blocks.en: When the count feels complete, do one final sweep of low-contrast and peripheral areas.
blocks.zh: 当计数完成时,对低相干和外围地区进行最后一次扫荡。

blocks.en: When the target category could be counted as a whole set or as individual pieces, decide which unit the question asks for before counting and apply it consistently.
blocks.zh: 当目标类别可算为一组或单个片段时,在计数前决定问题要求的哪个单位,并一致适用.

blocks.en: When your first pass finds zero instances, run a second pass assuming the category may appear in an unusual, stylized, or partially occluded form before concluding it is absent.
blocks.zh: 当您第一次通过发现零例时,运行第二次通过 假设该类可能以不寻常的,有型的,或部分被占用的形式出现,然后结束它是缺席的.

blocks.en: Locate exactly one object matching the full phrase. Interpret spatial terms from the viewer’s perspective.
blocks.zh: 精确定位一个匹配完整短语的对象 。 从取景者的角度来解释空间术语.

blocks.en: When multiple same-category candidates exist, verify that the chosen object satisfies every word of the referring expression, especially spatial qualifiers.
blocks.zh: 当存在多个同类别候选人时,核实所选对象满足了参考表达的每个字,特别是空间限定词.

blocks.en: For ordinal expressions such as “2nd from left,” count from the edge explicitly named in the phrase.
blocks.zh: 对于诸如“从左到左的第2个”之类的正文表达式,从短语中明确命名的边缘算起。

blocks.zh: 图15:精致感知的提取能力技能。

blocks.zh: 只应用匹配当前问题类型的任务部分;忽略其它问题。

blocks.zh: 当任务涉及相继操作时,在进行前每一步后更新工作状态.

blocks.en: Do not use dataset names, filenames, memorized examples, or external information.
blocks.zh: 不要使用数据集名称、文件名、被记住的例子或外部信息。

blocks.en: When reading values from a chart, align with the nearest labeled gridline or tick mark—do not estimate between lines.
blocks.zh: 从图表读取值时, 与最近的标签网格线或勾选标记对齐- 不要在行间估计 。

blocks.en: When comparing two values, confirm whether the question asks for an absolute difference or a ratio.
blocks.zh: 在比较两个值时,确认问题是要求绝对差还是要求比例.

blocks.en: When a chart has dual axes or multiple series, verify that the value is read from the correct axis and series.
blocks.zh: 当一图有双轴或多序列时,验证该值是从正确的轴和序列读取.

blocks.en: When identifying a peak or extremum, cross-reference its position with both axes to confirm the exact value.
blocks.zh: 在识别出一个峰或极点时,将其位置与两个轴相交叉以确认准确值。

blocks.en: When the answer’s magnitude seems implausible given the chart’s visual scale, re-read the value against the axis markings.
blocks.zh: 如果从图表的视觉尺度看,答案的分量似乎不可信,则对照轴标重新读取数值。

blocks.en: When transcribing text, verify that no visible text region was skipped by scanning page edges and corners.
blocks.zh: 翻转文本时, 请确认扫描页面边缘和角时没有跳过可见文本区域 。

blocks.en: When extracting data from a multi-page document, verify that the answer comes from the page matching the question’s context rather than a visually similar page.
blocks.zh: 在从多页文档中提取数据时,验证答案来自与问题上下文相匹配的页面而不是视觉相近的页面.

blocks.en: When the question asks about a relationship or flow, trace connecting arrows or lines in the diagram before answering.
blocks.zh: 当问题问到关系或流时,在回答前在图中追踪连接箭头或行.

blocks.en: When listing categories from a chart or table, ensure that all items are captured.
blocks.zh: 在从图表或表格中列出类别时,确保所有项目都得到记录。

blocks.en: When the answer’s magnitude seems implausible given the visual scale, re-check the relevant values.
blocks.zh: 如果从视觉尺度看答案的大小似乎不可信,请重新检查相关的数值。

blocks.en: When transcribing text, verify that no visible text region was skipped.
blocks.zh: 转录文本时, 请确认没有跳过可见文本区域 。

blocks.en: Scan every region systematically, including the main body, headers, footers, captions, footnotes, watermarks, stamps, and table cells.
blocks.zh: 系统地扫描每个区域,包括正文、页眉、页脚、标题、脚注、水印、邮票和表格单元格。

blocks.en: For multi-column or multi-region layouts, transcribe each region in natural reading order and preserve completeness.
blocks.zh: 对于多栏或多区域布局,按自然读取顺序对每个区域进行转录并保持完整性.

blocks.en: For long CJK text, read each line fully before moving to the next line; do not merge lines or skip characters.
blocks.zh: 对于长 CJK 文本,在移动到下行前全部读取每行;不合并行或跳过字符.

blocks.en: When uncertain whether a faint or partial region contains real text, prefer preserving potentially valid text rather than omitting an entire region.
blocks.zh: 当不确定某一区域是否包含真实文本时,倾向于保留可能有效的文本,而不是省略整个区域。

blocks.en: Re-scan the four edges and every column or region of the image and confirm that no visible text line was skipped or truncated.
blocks.zh: 重新扫描图像的四边和每个列或区域,并确认没有跳过或切出可见的文本行 。

blocks.zh: 只应用匹配当前问题类型的任务部分;忽略其它问题。

blocks.zh: 不要使用数据集名称、文件名、被记住的例子或外部信息。

blocks.en: When a derivation yields a result, verify that it is consistent with the diagram’s visible proportions; if the computed length or angle is implausible, re-check the derivation and arithmetic.
blocks.zh: 当推算得出结果时,核实它是否与图的可见比例一致;如果计算出的长度或角度不可信,则重新检查推算和算术。

blocks.en: For multi-step derivations, solve each intermediate quantity explicitly and carry it forward to avoid propagating arithmetic errors.
blocks.zh: 对于多步骤的衍生,明确解决每个中间数量,并推进,以避免传播算术错误.

blocks.en: Confirm that the answer is a bare numeric value, with no option letter or units appended.
blocks.zh: 确认答案为赤数值,没有附加选项字母或单位.

blocks.en: For inductive pattern or sequence puzzles, identify the simplest visual rule consistent with all given figures—such as rotation, color or shape cycles, or element addition/removal—and apply it forward.
blocks.zh: 对于入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入

blocks.en: For other puzzle types, rely on direct visual inspection or straightforward reasoning rather than unnecessarily applying pattern-detection rules.
blocks.zh: 对于其他拼图类型,依靠直接的视觉检查或直截了当的推理,而不是不必要地应用模式-检测规则.

blocks.en: When choosing among options, compute the answer independently first and then match it to the corresponding option; do not let the answer choices bias the derivation.
blocks.zh: 在选项中选择时,先独立计算答案,然后将其与相应的选项相匹配;不要让答案选择偏向衍生.

blocks.en: Confirm that the final answer is an option letter (A, B, C, or D).
blocks.zh: 确认最后的答案是选项字母(A,B,C,或D).

blocks.en: Figure 17: Extracted Capability skill for multimodal symbolic reasoning.
blocks.zh: 图17:多式联运象征性推理的提取能力技能。

blocks.en: Apply ONLY the task section matching the current question type; ignore the others.
blocks.zh: 只应用匹配当前问题类型的任务部分;忽略其它问题。

blocks.en: When the task involves sequential operations, update the working state after each step before proceeding.
blocks.zh: 当任务涉及相继操作时,在进行前每一步后更新工作状态.

blocks.en: Do not use dataset names, filenames, memorized examples, or external information.
blocks.zh: 不要使用数据集名称、文件名、被记住的例子或外部信息。

blocks.en: When comparing images for thematic or semantic similarity, verify that at least two distinct, non-redundant visual anchors are consistent across candidate images.
blocks.zh: 在比较主题或语义相似性的图像时,验证候选图像之间至少有两个不同的,非重复的视觉主播一致.

blocks.en: When evaluating whether a collection of images satisfies a condition, confirm the relevant quantifier: a universal claim fails if any required image contradicts it, whereas an existential claim requires only one valid instance.
blocks.zh: 在评估收集的图像是否满足一个条件时,确认相关的限定词:如果任何需要的图像与它相矛盾,普遍要求无效,而存在要求只需要一个有效的实例。

blocks.en: When identifying a paired comparison, verify that the images share a meaningful semantic or structural relationship rather than superficial visual resemblance.
blocks.zh: 在识别成对比较时,验证图像是否具有有意义的语义或结构关系,而不是表面的视觉相像.

blocks.en: When no candidate image matches the reference in key structural or spatial anchors, do not force a comparison.
blocks.zh: 当没有候选图像与关键结构或空间锚地中的引用相匹配时,不要强制进行比较.

blocks.en: When judging whether images share the same scene, building, or identity, prioritize stable structural anchors over decorative or transient elements.
blocks.zh: 在判断图像是否共享同一场景,建筑,或身份时,优先考虑稳定的结构锚地而不是装饰或瞬间元素.

blocks.en: Confirm that the selected answer is uniquely supported by the visual evidence.
blocks.zh: 确认选中的答案唯一有视觉证据支持 。

blocks.en: Do not infer absence solely because an object or motion is not clearly visible.
blocks.zh: 不要仅仅因为物体或运动不明显而推断缺席。

blocks.en: For directional or quantifier reasoning, verify that the correct reference frame and logical interpretation have been used.
blocks.zh: 对于方向性或限定性推理,核实是否使用了正确的参考框架和逻辑解释.

blocks.en: When evaluating directional terms such as “turned to the right” or “facing left,” confirm the intended reference frame rather than relying on image tilt or an object’s internal orientation.
blocks.zh: 在评价诸如 " 向右倒转 " 或 " 向左倒转 " 等取向性术语时,确认意图参考框架,而不是依赖图像倾斜或物体的内部取向。

blocks.en: When a statement specifies a spatial relationship, interpret it literally unless the question explicitly introduces another reference frame.
blocks.zh: 当一个语句指定了空间关系时,从字面上解释,除非问题明确引入了另一个参考框架.

blocks.en: When a “cannot be determined” option is available and a precise answer requires information that is not visually recoverable, prefer the insufficient-information option rather than inferring unsupported details.
blocks.zh: 如果存在“无法确定”的选项,而准确的答案则需要无法视同可收回的信息,则倾向于信息不足选项,而不是推断无佐证的细节。

blocks.en: Confirm that the selected answer is uniquely supported by the visual evidence.
blocks.zh: 确认选中的答案唯一有视觉证据支持 。

blocks.en: Avoid reasoning based on inferred absence when the relevant evidence is not visible.
blocks.zh: 在相关证据不明显时,避免根据推定缺席进行推理。

blocks.en: Verify the interpretation of directional and quantifier relations before producing the final answer.
blocks.zh: 在给出最终答案之前,验证方向和定性关系的解释。
